entities.summary: Hironimus Pakaenoni, sometimes Jerome Ronald Packaemonniy, is an Indonesian prelate of the Catholic Church who is the archbishop of the Archdiocese of Kupang since 2024. He was appointed Metropolitan Archbishop of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Kupang on 9 March 2024 to succeed Mons. Peter Turang.
